name: Paso Robles Willow Creek District

known.article: Paso Robles Willow Creek District AVA
known.via: English Wikipedia "Paso Robles Willow Creek District AVA"

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: With hot days and cool sea-air evenings, Paso Robles makes Zinfandel known for being soft and round.

blurb.text: A mountainous district inside the Paso Robles AVA.
